√rabh 'take hold'
present: [1.] rábhate etc. V.+ rábhati etc. S.+ rambhati rambhate E.+ 
perfect: rebhé etc. V.+ rārabhe rarabhmá 
aorist: [1.] arambhi -- [3.] ararambhat -- [4.] árabdha 
future: [1.] rapsyate etc. E.+ rapsyati -- [2.] rabdhā 
verbal: rabdhá V.+ rabdhum -rábhya V.+ -rábham -rábhe 
secondary: passive: rabhyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: rārabh- rārambh- -- desiderative: ripsate etc. -- causative: rambhayati etc. B.+ rambhayate 
derivatives: rabha -rábhya B.+ rábhas V.+ rabhasāná RV. ráṣbhi V.+ -rabhin V.S. -rabdhi C. -rabdhavya E. rabdhṛ C. rábhiṣṭha V.B. rábhīyas B.S. rábhyas RV. rambhá V.+ rambhaka C. rambhín V.+ -rámbhana V.+ -rambhanīya B.S. -ripsu C. 
Compare √labh, which is the same in another phonetic form.
